name: Arteria Raelius
source:
A young lady of the Larius family who is hospitalized in Sephirot. Her nickname is "Lusha."

Because she manifested and acquired the magic of 《Healing》 in her early childhood, she has been receiving treatment at Sephirot for a long time in order to analyze it.

She likes jokes and is usually messing around, so she often troubles the staff at Sephirot, but because she is cheerful and always smiling, they cannot bring themselves to hate her.

She has known Theodore since childhood and, without caring what others think, she publicly declares that "I will marry Teo in the future," but he always skillfully deflects her.
